website.rationale: The homepage download cards name platforms and package files only and make no per-platform update claim, so Linux in-app updates need no homepage change. The privacy policy's Update Checks and Downloads section already covers signed package downloads from GitHub Releases for every platform; Linux installation uses the already-downloaded package through local Polkit and offline APT, adding no recipient or data. The crash-prompt fix changes when a saved report is read locally, not what is sent.
